title: Echo Flight incident
summary: Robert Salas tells of Echo Flight incident, about March 16, 1967 at Echo Flight, Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Echo Flight, Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana

tellings.quote: at first he couldn't believe what they were saying, but uh, very shortly after that, all 10 of his missiles went down.
the Echo Flight case eight days before and all the cases since at Malmstrom
tellings.difference: Told by the host, who places it eight days before Salas's own incident and ties it to later Malmstrom cases.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 1967 Echo Flight missile shutdown at Malmstrom.
